subject: crossks: forbid cross ks session to access user tables and run DDL (#62270)
summary: Reviewed db81dee5 relative to its first parent, scoped to planner/session/sessionctx. Change adds `IsCrossKS()` plumbing to `planctx.PlanContext` and `sessionctx.Context`, stores an explicit `crossKS` flag on `session` (since `dom any` may hold a typed-nil), and blocks all `ast.DDLNode` planning in `PlanBuilder.Build` when `IsCrossKS()` is true. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/transaction/session behavior for the touched planner/session/sessionctx paths; later upstream/master history shows no subsequent fixups to this logic (only unrelated refactors).
